WITH joined AS (
  SELECT st.healtheval AS status,
         s.scancount AS scancount,
         1.0 * s.gbsize / s.spanmin AS ratio
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
),
grp AS (
  SELECT status,
         SUM(scancount) AS sum_scans,
         AVG(ratio) AS grp_avg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM grp
)
SELECT g.status,
       g.sum_scans,
       g.grp_avg,
       g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg
